data.description: Following the pattern from D-20260102-115907 and D-20260102-120452: Sprint, Task, Decision, and KT now have context fields. Edge and Handoff could benefit from optional notes fields for explaining WHY a relationship exists or what context led to a handoff.

properties.retrospective: Completed context capture for Edge (added reason field). Handoff already had instructions field. Context capture pattern now consistent across all GoT entity types: Task (description), Decision (rationale), Sprint (notes), Edge (reason), Handoff (instructions).

data.title: Extend context capture pattern to Edge and Handoff entities
